2025-04-25.riddle: You enter a dark room that contains a match, kerosene lamp, candle, and fireplace. What should you light first?
2025-04-25.hint: You need to start a flame before using anything else.

2025-04-26.riddle: I can be full of holes but still hold things together. What am I?
2025-04-26.hint: You might use me in the kitchen or bathroom to clean up a mess.

2025-04-27.riddle: I never move, yet I travel thousands of miles. I never speak, yet my message changes lives. What am I?

2025-04-28.riddle: The more you look at me, the less you can see. I blind without light and hide the clearest paths. I can cover a forest or a single street. What am I?
2025-04-28.hint: I blur your sight without darkness, wrapping roads and forests in a white, heavy veil.

2025-04-29.riddle: I stretch across the sky but never fall. You may chase me, but you’ll never reach me. Sometimes I end in gold, but you must believe to see it. What am I?
2025-04-29.hint: I appear after the rain when sunlight and water meet in the sky

2025-04-30.riddle: I am ancient yet always new. I rewrite myself each moment, but you can only read me looking backward. What am I?
2025-04-30.hint: I record the past but never predict the future.
